Meeting Notes — Project Phoenix Kickoff
Date: July 24, 2026
Attendees: Sarah Chen (PM), David Okafor (Engineering Lead), Maria Santos (Design)

Key decisions:
- Launch target: October 15, 2026
- MVP scope: Authentication, dashboard, and reporting modules only
- Design system: Adopt Nexoma Design System v2

Action items:
- David to provide technical architecture draft by August 1
- Maria to share initial wireframes by July 31
- Sarah to schedule weekly sync starting July 28
